paragraphs.text: Rahel was a Serra Angel who was summoned by Eskil to fight Trine and free northern Corondor from the Enslavement of Trine .

Seeing the purity in Eskil's soul, Rahel agreed to fight. The two angels fought, and Rahel killed her former sister, leading to the Absolution of Trine , where Rahel forgave Trine for her actions and returned her to the realm of Serra , reclaiming the white mana of her being.
Rahel later wrote down the story of Ravidel .
